ارتفعوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَفَعُوا (irtafaʕū) /ir.ta.fa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
# اِرْتَفِعُوا (irtafiʕū) /ir.ta.fi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
